title: RHIBOT II - Medium- and long-term efficacy of two ultrasound-guided intra-articular injections of onabotulinumtoxinA (Botox®) combined with custom-made rigid splinting in painful base-of-thumb osteoarthritis : a randomized double-blind controlled trial in three-parallel arms
official: RHIBOT II - Medium- and long-term efficacy of two ultrasound-guided intra-articular injections of onabotulinumtoxinA (Botox®) combined with custom-made rigid splinting in painful base-of-thumb osteoarthritis : a randomized double-blind controlled trial in three-parallel arms
summary: Main objective: Our main objective will be to compare the effects of 2 intra-articular injections of onabotulinumtoxinA with those of 1 intra-articular injection of onabotulinumtoxinA and 1 of normal saline and those of 2 intra-articular injections of normal saline on base-of-thumb pain at 6 months after the first injection
conditions: Adults aged at least 18 years with painful base-of-thumb osteoarthritis

interventions.name: BOTOX 50 UNITÉS ALLERGAN, poudre pour solution injectable
